name: select-method-ok-200
note: POST /api/analysis/select-method ranking, rows 05 and 09 transcribed verbatim from config/analysis_methods.yaml with rubric rank_reason strings (analysis/method_register_rubric.py); rank 1 leads unconstrained, rank 2 loses on complexity tier. Re-record against a running server.

recommendations.name: TF-IDF keyphrase scan
recommendations.summary: Rank words and word sequences by document frequency and corpus rarity to find distinctive wording.
recommendations.selection_notes: First to understand the main vocabulary. YAKE (07) is the low-setup peer.
recommendations.robustness_caveat: Sensitive to document boundaries, vocabulary filtering, and repeated boilerplate.
recommendations.bias_risk: Rare wording can rank highly without research importance.
recommendations.efficiency_workload: Sparse text-matrix construction and ranking over n text units. CPU-oriented.
recommendations.output_shape: Ranked terms and phrases with TF-IDF weights and document links.
recommendations.usage_guidance: Inspect corpus vocabulary, find search terms, and improve retrieval.
recommendations.validation_required: Review tokenization, common words, phrase lengths, and the top-ranked terms.
recommendations.permitted_claims: Descriptions of distinctive wording in the corpus.
recommendations.do_not_claim: Do not call the ranked list themes.
recommendations.rank_reason: Best row under the rubric order.

recommendations.name: Unsupervised BERTopic
recommendations.summary: Embed text, group similar representations, and describe each group with class-based TF-IDF terms.
recommendations.selection_notes: Next for groups that need topic descriptors. Not a substitute for question-by-case evidence.
recommendations.robustness_caveat: Clusters depend on embeddings, dimensionality reduction, and clustering settings.
recommendations.bias_risk: Small or dispersed groups can be treated as outliers.
recommendations.efficiency_workload: One embedding pass over n text units plus CPU grouping. Repeated model searches add cost.
recommendations.output_shape: Cluster ids, topic terms, representative records, and outlier records.
recommendations.usage_guidance: Build an exploratory corpus map and sample records for inspection.
recommendations.validation_required: Review segmentation and clustering settings. Inspect clusters and outliers. Repeat with controlled changes.
recommendations.permitted_claims: Exploratory corpus maps with cluster descriptions.
recommendations.do_not_claim: Do not present a topic representation as a validated research theme.
recommendations.rank_reason: Complexity tier is higher than the record above.
